name: smwgraphics-dry-bones-yoshi
title: Dry Bones Yoshi
description:
A scrapped dry bones Yoshi from Yoshi's Island, but redone to replace yoshi in your hack!

the .zip file includes:

-GFX33.bin adult Yoshi and baby Yoshi
-GFX13.bin Yoshi's tongue and eating frame
-drybonesyoshi.pal pallete file, it contains the extra colors yoshi uses
-drybonesyoshi.palmask use with drybonesyoshi.pal
